integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally.

[Shot 1] Chinese celestial palace, ethereal xianxia realm in the heavenly court. The camera executes a slow orbit with small amplitude at slow speed, beginning from the side-rear of a fictional xianxia character and moving to their side-front. The scene features a vast architecture dwarfing tiny human figures, with three-tier spatial layers: foreground columns framing, middle sea of clouds, and background grand palace silhouette at horizon. Strict central-axis symmetry dominates the composition, with one-point perspective vanishing to infinity. At least one floating structure, a sky bridge, extends into the mist. The environment is a cold blue-gray low-saturation night, dominated by moon white and ice blue tones. The only high-saturation warm accents are on the character's costume: a flowing vermilion robe with clear silk texture and subtle micro-reflections. The lighting is high-contrast low-key, with cold moonlight providing rim light on the robe's edges and the jade-white star platform showing a温润 matte finish.

At 00:00.000, the camera is positioned at the character's side-rear. The character, a slender xianxia figure, stands before a colossal suspended mirror. The mirror's surface reflects a chaotic nebula of star-rivers and fog, exhibiting a semi-transparent fluid particle quality. The camera begins its slow orbit. As it moves, the mist within the mirror gradually coalesces. By 00:02.500, the chaotic fog starts to organize. The character remains still, gazing at the mirror, their posture reverent and focused. The depth of field is shallow, keeping the character's collar and face in sharp focus while the background mirror and distant clouds blur into soft bokeh.

At 00:05.000, the character straightens their back. Simultaneously, distinct cyan density layers emerge from the mirror's fog, resembling rippling water or stratified data, glowing with a soft internal cold light. The character raises one hand in a subtle, graceful gesture, fingers extended. As the hand moves, a single, brilliant gold baseline materializes horizontally across the mirror's star-field. This gold line is the sole warm highlight in the frame, cutting through the cold blues. The chaotic fog along this line instantly orders itself into precise, parallel strata. The camera continues its slow orbit, revealing the full relationship between the character, the mirror, and the ordered cosmos. The visual ends with the gold line stable and the density layers perfectly aligned, the character standing as the central anchor between the mortal realm and the cosmic data. No person appears in this shot besides the main character. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, resonant ambient drone characteristic of a celestial void, layered with the subtle, crisp sound of silk fabric shifting as the character moves. The sound design features a low-frequency hum from the mirror's energy, punctuated by a sharp, ethereal chime when the gold baseline forms, creating a sense of cosmic precision and ancient power. The atmosphere is cold, vast, and meticulously controlled.
